messages:
ajay: Heads-up — opened PR 842 to add staging overlay for db-write service. It wires KMS-encrypted secret and updates kustomize overlay to include rds-replica. Need eyes on secrets wiring + whether gating policy should block prod. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/842

sarah: looking... quick question — are we adding a new KMS key or reusing existing infra/rds-key?

ajay: reusing infra/rds-key. terraform snippet in PR:
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "rds_key" {
  # referenced, not created
}
module "secrets" {
  source = "git::ssh://git.redwood/terraform/secrets.git//kms"
  kms_key_id = var.kms_key_id
}
```
I left kms_key_id as var pulled from env overlay.

katie: security: we need key policy to include audit role and require rotation tag. Also add `kms:GenerateDataKey*` restricted to vault-service account. Please add an entry in the audit log config.

ryan: regarding gating — current release-gate checks are:
- terraform plan (no resource drift)
- k8s manifest schema check (kubeval)
- overlay-namespace whitelist
If the overlay references existing KMS, plan will be noop for key but secrets module must pass plan. Can we add a CI stage to run `terraform plan -target=module.secrets` so we catch missconfigs?

ajay: yes I can add that. Also need confirmation on namespace: staging -> `staging-west`? @ryan

ryan: correct, staging-west. Also add a `gate:` label on the PR if you want it included in the scheduled rollout. Without it the rollout pipeline will skip until manual approval.

ci-bot: build/infra-pr-842 — terraform fmt OK

ajay: I've pushed an update with plan-only job and a kubeval check. PTAL @sarah @katie

sarah: review done. minor nit in var naming, otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup:

katie: added comment about key policy and audit resource in PR. security ok to proceed once key policy is present.

ajay: thanks — I'll add key policy and tag rotation. Can someone with prod-gate perms add `gate:staging->prod` after we run canary?

ryan: I'll take care of the prod gate when staging is green. Ping me after canary run.

ajay: will do. planning to deploy to staging in next slot (in ~30m). If anything fails, I'll rollback and open incident thread.

ci-bot: terraform plan (module.secrets) — PASSED

katie: :eyes: good luck

ajay: deploying now. will update with results.
